SETTINGS & INFORMATION

Your drive settings.

Demo route

Delta estimates your pace from device location and available road data. The signed time delta compares your progress with a known reference speed limit. It is an estimate, never an instruction to speed up.

Coverage & limits

Road coverage is loading. Limits and exit locations may be missing or outdated. Missing or implausible speed tags use a clearly marked assumed 50 km/h reference. Pace delta activates only after confirmed expressway tracking.

Expressway Average Speed Enforcement (EASE) boundaries are unverified here. Delta does not identify enforcement zones or assess compliance. Always follow current signs and conditions.

Location & privacy

Live location is processed on this device for the dashboard. No journey is uploaded. The location watch stops when you change modes or close the page. The offline app shell can be cached on this device.

Data attribution will appear here when available.

BEFORE YOU BEGIN

Park first.

Set up Delta only while parked. Do not look at or interact with this display while driving. Follow road signs and conditions.
